sanskrit_iast:
yasyonmeṣanimeṣābhyāṃ jagataḥ pralayodayau |
taṃ śakticakravibhavaprabhavaṃ śaṅkaraṃ stumaḥ || 1 ||
meaning:
यस्योन्मेषनिमेषाभ्यां जगतः प्रलयोदयौ |
तं शक्तिचक्रविभवप्रभवं शङ्करं स्तुमः || 1 ||
text_mt: We praise that Śaṅkara, the source of the glory of the wheel of powers, / by whose opening and closing of the eyes the dissolution and emergence of the world [take place]. || 1
title: prathamo niḥṣyandaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
yatra sthitam idaṃ sarvaṃ kāryaṃ yasmāc ca nirgataṃ |
tasyānāvṛtarūpatvān na nirodho 'sti kutracit || 2 ||
meaning:
यत्र स्थितम् इदं सर्वं कार्यं यस्माच् च निर्गतं |
तस्यानावृतरूपत्वान् न निरोधो ऽस्ति कुत्रचित् || 2 ||
text_mt: Since that in which all this effect rests and from which it has emerged / is of an unobscured nature, there is nowhere any obstruction to it. || 2

sanskrit_iast:
jāgradādi vibhede 'pi tadabhinne prasarpati |
nivartate nijānnaiva svabhāvād upalabdhṛtaḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
जाग्रदादि विभेदे ऽपि तदभिन्ने प्रसर्पति |
निवर्तते निजान्नैव स्वभावाद् उपलब्धृतः || 3 ||
text_mt: Even when the manifold states of waking and the like expand, being non-different from it, / it never departs from its own nature as the perceiver. || 3

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ sukhī ca duḥkhī ca raktaś ca ityadisamvidaḥ |
sukhādyavasthānusyūte vartante 'nyatra tāḥ sphuṭam || 4 ||
meaning:
अहं सुखी च दुःखी च रक्तश् च इत्यदिसम्विदः |
सुखाद्यवस्थानुस्यूते वर्तन्ते ऽन्यत्र ताः स्फुटम् || 4 ||
text_mt: Cognitions such as "I am happy," "[I am] suffering," and "[I am] attached" / clearly abide in another [substratum], threaded through the states of pleasure and the like. || 4

sanskrit_iast:
na duḥkhaṃ na sukhaṃ yatra na grāhyam grāhakaṃ na ca |
na cāsti mūḍhabhāvo 'pi tad asti paramārthataḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
न दुःखं न सुखं यत्र न ग्राह्यम् ग्राहकं न च |
न चास्ति मूढभावो ऽपि तद् अस्ति परमार्थतः || 5 ||
text_mt: Where there is neither pain nor pleasure, neither object nor subject, / nor even a state of stupor—that exists in the ultimate sense. || 5

sanskrit_iast:
yataḥ karaṇavargo 'yaṃ vimūḍho 'mūḍhavat svayam |
sahāntareṇa cakreṇa pravṛttisthitisaṃhṛtiḥ || 6 ||
meaning:
यतः करणवर्गो ऽयं विमूढो ऽमूढवत् स्वयम् |
सहान्तरेण चक्रेण प्रवृत्तिस्थितिसंहृतिः || 6 ||
text_mt: From which this set of senses, though insentient, [acts] by itself as if sentient, / together with the inner circle [of powers], in emergence, maintenance, and withdrawal— || 6

sanskrit_iast:
labhate tatprayatnena parīkṣyaṃ tattvam ādarāt |
yataḥ svatantratā tasya sarvatreyam akṛtrimā || 7 ||
meaning:
लभते तत्प्रयत्नेन परीक्ष्यं तत्त्वम् आदरात् |
यतः स्वतन्त्रता तस्य सर्वत्रेयम् अकृत्रिमा || 7 ||
text_mt: that reality must be examined with effort and reverence, / since this unconditioned freedom of it is [present] everywhere. || 7

sanskrit_iast:
na hīcchānodanasyāyam prerakatvena vartate |
api tv ātmabalasparśāt puruṣas tatsamo bhavet || 8 ||
meaning:
न हीच्छानोदनस्यायम् प्रेरकत्वेन वर्तते |
अपि त्व् आत्मबलस्पर्शात् पुरुषस् तत्समो भवेत् || 8 ||
text_mt: For this [individual self] does not act as the impeller of the urge of will; / rather, by contact with the power of the Self, a person becomes equal to it. || 8

sanskrit_iast:
nijāśuddhyāsamarthasya kartavyeṣv abhilāṣiṇaḥ |
yadā kṣobhaḥ pralīyeta tadā syāt paramam padam || 9 ||
meaning:
निजाशुद्ध्यासमर्थस्य कर्तव्येष्व् अभिलाषिणः |
यदा क्षोभः प्रलीयेत तदा स्यात् परमम् पदम् || 9 ||
text_mt: When the agitation of one who is powerless due to his own impurity, / desiring to perform actions, dissolves, then the supreme state arises. || 9

sanskrit_iast:
tadāsyākṛtrimo dharmo jñatvakartṛtvalakṣaṇah |
yatas tadepsitaṃ sarvaṃ jānāti ca karoti ca || 10 ||
meaning:
तदास्याकृत्रिमो धर्मो ज्ञत्वकर्तृत्वलक्षणह् |
यतस् तदेप्सितं सर्वं जानाति च करोति च || 10 ||
text_mt: Then his innate quality, characterized by knowledge and agency, [shines forth], / by which he knows and does everything desired by him. || 10

sanskrit_iast:
tam adhiṣṭhātṛbhāvena svabhāvam avalokayan |
smayamāna ivāste yas tasyeyaṃ kusṛtiḥ kutaḥ || 11 ||
meaning:
तम् अधिष्ठातृभावेन स्वभावम् अवलोकयन् |
स्मयमान इवास्ते यस् तस्येयं कुसृतिः कुतः || 11 ||
text_mt: Observing that own-nature in the state of a presiding ruler, / he who rests as if smiling—whence could this wretched cycle [arise] for him? || 11

sanskrit_iast:
nābhāvo bhāvyatām eti na ca tatrāsty amūḍhatā |
yato 'bhiyogasaṃsparśāt tadāsid iti niścayah || 12 ||
meaning:
नाभावो भाव्यताम् एति न च तत्रास्त्य् अमूढता |
यतो ऽभियोगसंस्पर्शात् तदासिद् इति निश्चयह् || 12 ||
text_mt: Non-existence cannot become an object of contemplation, nor is there absence of stupor in it, / because the conviction that "it existed then" [arises only] from contact with applied effort. || 12

sanskrit_iast:
atas tatkṛtrimaṃ jñeyaṃ sauṣuptapadavat sadā |
na tv evaṃ smaryamāṇatvaṃ tat tattvam pratipadyate || 13 ||
meaning:
अतस् तत्कृत्रिमं ज्ञेयं सौषुप्तपदवत् सदा |
न त्व् एवं स्मर्यमाणत्वं तत् तत्त्वम् प्रतिपद्यते || 13 ||
text_mt: Therefore, that should always be known as artificial, like the state of deep sleep; / but that reality does not attain the condition of being remembered in this manner. || 13

sanskrit_iast:
avasthāyugalaṃ cātra kāryakartṛtvaśabditam |
kāryatā kṣayiṇī tatra kartṛtvam punar akṣayam || 14 ||
meaning:
अवस्थायुगलं चात्र कार्यकर्तृत्वशब्दितम् |
कार्यता क्षयिणी तत्र कर्तृत्वम् पुनर् अक्षयम् || 14 ||
text_mt: And here the pair of states is designated as effect and agency: / of these, the state of effect is perishable, but agency is imperishable. || 14

sanskrit_iast:
kāryonmukhaḥ prayatno yaḥ kevalaṃ so 'tra lupyate |
tasmin lupte vilupto 'smīty abudhaḥ pratipadyate || 15 ||
meaning:
कार्योन्मुखः प्रयत्नो यः केवलं सो ऽत्र लुप्यते |
तस्मिन् लुप्ते विलुप्तो ऽस्मीत्य् अबुधः प्रतिपद्यते || 15 ||
text_mt: Only the exertion directed toward an effect is dissolved here; / when that is dissolved, the unwise person thinks: "I am destroyed." || 15

sanskrit_iast:
na tu yo 'ntarmukho bhāvah sarvajñātvaguṇāspadam |
tasya lopaḥ kadācit syād anyasyānupalambhanāt || 16 ||
meaning:
न तु यो ऽन्तर्मुखो भावह् सर्वज्ञात्वगुणास्पदम् |
तस्य लोपः कदाचित् स्याद् अन्यस्यानुपलम्भनात् || 16 ||
text_mt: However, that inward state which is the abode of the attribute of omniscience / could never suffer dissolution, because no other [perceiver] is observed. || 16

sanskrit_iast:
tasyopalabdhiḥ satataṃ tripadāvyabhicāriṇī |
nityaṃ syāt suprabuddhasya tadādyante parasya tu || 17 ||
meaning:
तस्योपलब्धिः सततं त्रिपदाव्यभिचारिणी |
नित्यं स्यात् सुप्रबुद्धस्य तदाद्यन्ते परस्य तु || 17 ||
text_mt: For the fully awakened, the apprehension of that [reality] is constant and invariable / in all three states; but for the other [person, it occurs] at their beginning and end. || 17

sanskrit_iast:
jñānajñeyasvarūpiṇyā śaktyā paramayā yutaḥ |
padadvaye vibhur bhāti tadanyatra tu cinmayaḥ || 18 ||
meaning:
ज्ञानज्ञेयस्वरूपिण्या शक्त्या परमया युतः |
पदद्वये विभुर् भाति तदन्यत्र तु चिन्मयः || 18 ||
text_mt: Endowed with the supreme power having the nature of knowledge and the known, / the omnipresent Lord shines in the two states, but elsewhere [in the fourth state] as pure consciousness. || 18

sanskrit_iast:
guṇādispandaniḥṣyandāḥ sāmānyaspandasaṃśrayāt |
labdhātmalābhaḥ satataṃ syur jñasyāparipanthinaḥ || 19 ||
meaning:
गुणादिस्पन्दनिःष्यन्दाः सामान्यस्पन्दसंश्रयात् |
लब्धात्मलाभः सततं स्युर् ज्ञस्यापरिपन्थिनः || 19 ||
text_mt: The outflows of vibration [such as] the qualities and the rest, having attained their own existence / by relying on the universal vibration, are never obstructive to the wise. || 19

sanskrit_iast:
aprabudhadhiyas tv ete svasthitisthaganodyatāḥ |
pātayanti duruttāre ghore saṃsāravartmani || 20 ||
meaning:
अप्रबुधधियस् त्व् एते स्वस्थितिस्थगनोद्यताः |
पातयन्ति दुरुत्तारे घोरे संसारवर्त्मनि || 20 ||
text_mt: But for those of unawakened intellect, these [outflows], intent on concealing their true state, / cause them to fall into the terrible and insurmountable path of transmigration. || 20

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ satatam udyuktaḥ spandatattvaviviktaye |
jāgrad eva nijam bhāvam acireṇādhigacchati || 21 ||
meaning:
अतः सततम् उद्युक्तः स्पन्दतत्त्वविविक्तये |
जाग्रद् एव निजम् भावम् अचिरेणाधिगच्छति || 21 ||
text_mt: Therefore, always striving for the discernment of the principle of vibration, / [a person], remaining awake, quickly attains his innate nature. || 21

sanskrit_iast:
atikruddhaḥ prahṛṣṭo vā kiṃ karomīti vā mṛśan |
dhāvan va yat padaṃ gacchet tatra spandaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 22 ||
meaning:
अतिक्रुद्धः प्रहृष्टो वा किं करोमीति वा मृशन् |
धावन् व यत् पदं गच्छेत् तत्र स्पन्दः प्रतिष्ठितः || 22 ||
text_mt: Extremely enraged, or delighted, or pondering "what should I do?", / or running—whatever state one reaches, therein vibration is established. || 22

sanskrit_iast:
yām avasthāṃ samālambya yad ayam mama vakṣyati |
tadavaśyaṃ kariṣye 'ham iti saṃkalpya tiṣṭhati || 23 ||
meaning:
याम् अवस्थां समालम्ब्य यद् अयम् मम वक्ष्यति |
तदवश्यं करिष्ये ऽहम् इति संकल्प्य तिष्ठति || 23 ||
text_mt: Depending on which state, he remains having resolved: / "Whatever this [principle] tells me, I will certainly do that." || 23

sanskrit_iast:
tām aśrityordhvamārgeṇa candrasūryāv ubhāv api |
sauṣumne 'dhvanyastamito hitvā brahmāṇḍagocaram || 24 ||
meaning:
ताम् अश्रित्योर्ध्वमार्गेण चन्द्रसूर्याव् उभाव् अपि |
सौषुम्ने ऽध्वन्यस्तमितो हित्वा ब्रह्माण्डगोचरम् || 24 ||
text_mt: Resorting to that [state], both the moon and the sun / set in the path of the suṣumnā by the ascending way, having abandoned the sphere of the cosmic egg.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tasmin mahāvyomni pralīnaśaśibhāskare |
sauṣuptapadavan mūḍhaḥ prabuddhaḥ syād anāvṛtaḥ || 25 ||
meaning:
तदा तस्मिन् महाव्योम्नि प्रलीनशशिभास्करे |
सौषुप्तपदवन् मूढः प्रबुद्धः स्याद् अनावृतः || 25 ||
text_mt: Then, in that great void where the moon and sun have dissolved, / the dull person remains as if in deep sleep, while the awakened one becomes unveiled. || 25

sanskrit_iast:
tadākramya balam mantrāḥ sarvajñābalaśālinaḥ |
pravartante 'dhikārāya karaṇānīva dehinām || 1 ||
meaning:
तदाक्रम्य बलम् मन्त्राः सर्वज्ञाबलशालिनः |
प्रवर्तन्ते ऽधिकाराय करणानीव देहिनाम् || 1 ||
text_mt: Resorting to that power, the mantras, endowed with the power of omniscience, / proceed to their function, like the senses of embodied beings. || 1
title: dvitīyo niḥṣyandaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva sampralīyante śāntarūpā nirañjanāḥ |
sahārādhakacittena tenaite śivadharmiṇaḥ || 2 ||
meaning:
तत्रैव सम्प्रलीयन्ते शान्तरूपा निरञ्जनाः |
सहाराधकचित्तेन तेनैते शिवधर्मिणः || 2 ||
text_mt: Right there, tranquil and stainless, they dissolve / along with the mind of the worshiper; therefore, they partake of the nature of Śiva. || 2

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāt sarvamayo jīvaḥ sarvabhāvasamudbhavāt |
tatsaṃvedanarūpeṇa tādātmyapratipattitaḥ || 3 ||
meaning:
यस्मात् सर्वमयो जीवः सर्वभावसमुद्भवात् |
तत्संवेदनरूपेण तादात्म्यप्रतिपत्तितः || 3 ||
text_mt: Since the individual soul is composed of all things, because of the arising of all entities [from it], / and through its cognition [of them] in the form of realization of identity, || 3

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāc chabdārthacintāsu na sāvasthā na yā śivaḥ |
bhoktaiva bhogyabhāvena sadā sarvatra saṃsthitaḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
तस्माच् छब्दार्थचिन्तासु न सावस्था न या शिवः |
भोक्तैव भोग्यभावेन सदा सर्वत्र संस्थितः || 4 ||
text_mt: therefore, among words, objects, and thoughts, there is no state that is not Śiva; / the experiencer alone always and everywhere abides in the form of the experienced. || 4

sanskrit_iast:
iti vā yasya saṃvittiḥ krīḍātvenākhilaṃ jagat |
sa paśyan satataṃ yukto jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ || 5 ||
meaning:
इति वा यस्य संवित्तिः क्रीडात्वेनाखिलं जगत् |
स पश्यन् सततं युक्तो जीवन्मुक्तो न संशयः || 5 ||
text_mt: Or rather, he who has this awareness, beholding the entire universe / as play, constantly integrated, is liberated while living, without doubt. || 5

sanskrit_iast:
ayam evodayas tasya dhyeyasya dhyāyicetasi |
tadātmatāsamāpattir icchataḥ sādhakasya yā || 6 ||
meaning:
अयम् एवोदयस् तस्य ध्येयस्य ध्यायिचेतसि |
तदात्मतासमापत्तिर् इच्छतः साधकस्य या || 6 ||
text_mt: This alone is the rising of that object of meditation in the mind of the meditator: / that absorption into its identity for the practitioner who desires it. || 6

sanskrit_iast:
iyam evāmṛtaprāptir ayam evātmano grahaḥ |
iyaṃ nirvāṇa-dīkṣā ca śivasadbhāvadāyini || 7 ||
meaning:
इयम् एवामृतप्राप्तिर् अयम् एवात्मनो ग्रहः |
इयं निर्वाण-दीक्षा च शिवसद्भावदायिनि || 7 ||
text_mt: This alone is the attainment of nectar, this alone is the apprehension of the Self; / and this is the initiation of liberation, which bestows the true state of Śiva. || 7

sanskrit_iast:
yathecchābhyarthito dhātā jāgrato 'rthān hṛdi sthitān
somasūryodayaṃ kṛtvā sampādayati dehinaḥ || 1 |
meaning:
यथेच्छाभ्यर्थितो धाता जाग्रतो ऽर्थान् हृदि स्थितान्
सोमसूर्योदयं कृत्वा सम्पादयति देहिनः || 1 |
text_mt: Just as the creator, petitioned by desire, brings about the objects dwelling in the heart / of the waking embodied soul by causing the rising of the moon and the sun, || 1
title: tṛtīyo niḥṣyandaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
tathā svapne 'py abhīṣṭārthān praṇayasyānatikramāt |
nityaṃ sphuṭataraṃ madhye sthito 'vaśyaṃ prakāśayet || 2 ||
meaning:
तथा स्वप्ने ऽप्य् अभीष्टार्थान् प्रणयस्यानतिक्रमात् |
नित्यं स्फुटतरं मध्ये स्थितो ऽवश्यं प्रकाशयेत् || 2 ||
text_mt: so also in dream, because longing is not transgressed, / residing in the middle, he will surely reveal the desired objects ever more clearly. || 2

sanskrit_iast:
anyathā tu svatantrā syāt sṛṣṭis taddharmakatvataḥ |
satataṃ laukikasyeva jāgratsvapnapadadvaye || 3 ||
meaning:
अन्यथा तु स्वतन्त्रा स्यात् सृष्टिस् तद्धर्मकत्वतः |
सततं लौकिकस्येव जाग्रत्स्वप्नपदद्वये || 3 ||
text_mt: Otherwise, creation would be autonomous, because of having that nature, / constantly in both states of waking and dream, just as for a common person. || 3

sanskrit_iast:
yathā hi artho 'sphuṭo dṛṣṭaḥ sāvadhāne 'pi cetasi |
bhūyaḥ sphuṭataro bhāti svabalodyogabhāvitaḥ || 4 ||
meaning:
यथा हि अर्थो ऽस्फुटो दृष्टः सावधाने ऽपि चेतसि |
भूयः स्फुटतरो भाति स्वबलोद्योगभावितः || 4 ||
text_mt: For just as an object seen indistinctly, even when the mind is attentive, / shines forth more clearly when cultivated by the exertion of one's own power, || 4

sanskrit_iast:
tathā yat paramārthena yena yatra yathā sthitam |
tat tathā balam ākramya na cirāt sampravartate || 5 ||
meaning:
तथा यत् परमार्थेन येन यत्र यथा स्थितम् |
तत् तथा बलम् आक्रम्य न चिरात् सम्प्रवर्तते || 5 ||
text_mt: so whatever exists in the ultimate sense, by whatever [form], wherever, and however— / resorting to that power, that operates thus without delay. || 5

sanskrit_iast:
durbalo 'pi tadākramya yataḥ kārye pravartate |
ācchādayed bubhukṣāṃ ca tathā yo 'ti bubhukṣitaḥ || 6 ||
meaning:
दुर्बलो ऽपि तदाक्रम्य यतः कार्ये प्रवर्तते |
आच्छादयेद् बुभुक्षां च तथा यो ऽति बुभुक्षितः || 6 ||
text_mt: For even a weak person, taking hold of that, acts in work; / and one who is extremely hungry can thus conceal his hunger. || 6

sanskrit_iast:
anenādhiṣṭhite dehe yathā sarvajñatādayaḥ |
tathā svātmany adhiṣṭhānāt sarvatraivam bhaviṣyati || 7 ||
meaning:
अनेनाधिष्ठिते देहे यथा सर्वज्ञतादयः |
तथा स्वात्मन्य् अधिष्ठानात् सर्वत्रैवम् भविष्यति || 7 ||
text_mt: Just as omniscience and the like [manifest] in the body when it is presided over by this, / so, from presiding in one's own Self, it will be so everywhere. || 7

sanskrit_iast:
glānir viluṇṭhikā dehe tasyāścājñānataḥ sṛtiḥ |
tad unmeṣaviluptaṃ cet kutaḥ sā syād ahetukā || 8 ||
meaning:
ग्लानिर् विलुण्ठिका देहे तस्याश्चाज्ञानतः सृतिः |
तद् उन्मेषविलुप्तं चेत् कुतः सा स्याद् अहेतुका || 8 ||
text_mt: Languor is a thief in the body, and its flow arises from ignorance; / if that is dissolved by the unfolding [of consciousness], how could it exist without a cause?

sanskrit_iast:
ekacintāprasaktasya yataḥ syād aparodayaḥ |
unmeṣaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ svayaṃ tam upalakṣayet || 9 ||
meaning:
एकचिन्ताप्रसक्तस्य यतः स्याद् अपरोदयः |
उन्मेषः स तु विज्ञेयः स्वयं तम् उपलक्षयेत् || 9 ||
text_mt: That from which another [thought] arises for one occupied with a single thought / is to be known as unmeṣa; one should observe it for oneself. || 9

sanskrit_iast:
ato bindur ato nādo rūpam asmād ato rasaḥ |
pravartante 'cireṇaiva kṣobhakatvena dehinaḥ || 10 ||
meaning:
अतो बिन्दुर् अतो नादो रूपम् अस्माद् अतो रसः |
प्रवर्तन्ते ऽचिरेणैव क्षोभकत्वेन देहिनः || 10 ||
text_mt: From this, the point; from this, the sound; from this, form; and from this, taste / arise without delay as agitating factors for the embodied soul. || 10

sanskrit_iast:
didṛkṣayeva sarvārthān yadā vyāpyāvatiṣṭhate |
tadā kiṃ bahunoktena svayam eva avabhotsyate || 11 ||
meaning:
दिदृक्षयेव सर्वार्थान् यदा व्याप्यावतिष्ठते |
तदा किं बहुनोक्तेन स्वयम् एव अवभोत्स्यते || 11 ||
text_mt: When one abides pervading all objects merely with the desire to perceive, / then why say much? One will understand by oneself. || 11

sanskrit_iast:
prabuddhaḥ sarvadā tiṣṭhej jñānenālokya gocaram |
ekatrāropayet sarvaṃ tato 'nyena na pīḍyate || 12 ||
meaning:
प्रबुद्धः सर्वदा तिष्ठेज् ज्ञानेनालोक्य गोचरम् |
एकत्रारोपयेत् सर्वं ततो ऽन्येन न पीड्यते || 12 ||
text_mt: One should always remain awakened, having illuminated the sense-sphere by knowledge; / one should deposit everything into the single [Reality]; then one is not troubled by another. || 12

sanskrit_iast:
śabdarāśisamutthasya śaktivargasya bhogyatām |
kalāviluptavibhavo gataḥ san sa paśuḥ smṛtaḥ || 13 ||
meaning:
शब्दराशिसमुत्थस्य शक्तिवर्गस्य भोग्यताम् |
कलाविलुप्तविभवो गतः सन् स पशुः स्मृतः || 13 ||
text_mt: Reduced to an object of enjoyment for the assembly of powers arisen from the multitude of sounds, / his majesty stripped away by the subtle parts, he is considered a bound soul (paśu). || 13

sanskrit_iast:
parāmṛtarasāpāyas tasya yaḥ pratyayodbhavaḥ |
tenāsvatantratām eti sa ca tanmātragocaraḥ || 14 ||
meaning:
परामृतरसापायस् तस्य यः प्रत्ययोद्भवः |
तेनास्वतन्त्रताम् एति स च तन्मात्रगोचरः || 14 ||
text_mt: The arising of discursive thought is for him the loss of the nectar-flavor of supreme [consciousness]; / through that he falls into dependence, and that [thought] has subtle elements as its field of perception. || 14

sanskrit_iast:
svarūpāvaraṇe cāsya śaktayaḥ satatotthitāḥ |
yataḥ śabdānuvedhena na vinā pratyayodbhavaḥ || 15 ||
meaning:
स्वरूपावरणे चास्य शक्तयः सततोत्थिताः |
यतः शब्दानुवेधेन न विना प्रत्ययोद्भवः || 15 ||
text_mt: And in concealing his true nature, the powers are continuously active, / because no arising of discursive thought occurs without being permeated by sound. || 15

sanskrit_iast:
seyaṃ kriyātmikā śaktiḥ śivasya paśuvartinī |
bandhayitrī svamārgasthā jñātā siddhyupapādikā || 16 ||
meaning:
सेयं क्रियात्मिका शक्तिः शिवस्य पशुवर्तिनी |
बन्धयित्री स्वमार्गस्था ज्ञाता सिद्ध्युपपादिका || 16 ||
text_mt: This very power of action belonging to Śiva, residing in the bound soul, / causes bondage when operating in its own realm; [yet] once known, it brings about liberation and power.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmātrodayarūpena mano 'haṃbuddhivartinā |
puryaṣṭakena saṃruddhas taduttham pratyayodbhavam || 17 ||
meaning:
तन्मात्रोदयरूपेन मनो ऽहंबुद्धिवर्तिना |
पुर्यष्टकेन संरुद्धस् तदुत्थम् प्रत्ययोद्भवम् || 17 ||
text_mt: Confined by the subtle body consisting of the arising of subtle elements / and existing in mind, ego, and intellect, he [experiences] the arising of thoughts born from it; || 17

sanskrit_iast:
bhuṅkte paravaśo bhogaṃ tadbhāvāt saṃsared ataḥ |
saṃsṛtipralayasyāsya kāraṇaṃ sampracakṣmahe || 18 ||
meaning:
भुङ्क्ते परवशो भोगं तद्भावात् संसरेद् अतः |
संसृतिप्रलयस्यास्य कारणं सम्प्रचक्ष्महे || 18 ||
text_mt: helpless, he experiences that pleasure and pain, and because of being that, he transmigrates; / therefore, we now explain the cause of the dissolution of this cycle of transmigration. || 18

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tv ekatra saṃrūḍhas tadā tasya layodayau |
niyacchan bhoktṛtām eti tataś cakreśvaro bhavet || 19 ||
meaning:
यदा त्व् एकत्र संरूढस् तदा तस्य लयोदयौ |
नियच्छन् भोक्तृताम् एति ततश् चक्रेश्वरो भवेत् || 19 ||
text_mt: When, however, he is firmly rooted in the One, then, controlling / the emergence and dissolution of that [subtle body], he attains the state of the enjoyer; thence he becomes the Lord of the Wheel. || 19

sanskrit_iast:
agādhasaṃśayāmbhodhisamuttaraṇatārinīm |
vande vicitrārthapadāṃ citrāṃ tāṃ gurubhāratīm || 1 ||
meaning:
अगाधसंशयाम्भोधिसमुत्तरणतारिनीम् |
वन्दे विचित्रार्थपदां चित्रां तां गुरुभारतीम् || 1 ||
text_mt: I praise the wonderful speech of the Guru, rich in varied meanings and expressions, / which ferries [one] across the unfathomable ocean of doubt. || 1
title: caturtho niḥṣyandaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
labdhvāpy alabhyam etaj jñānadhanaṃ hṛdguhāntakṛtanihiteḥ |
vasuguptavac chivāya hi bhavati sadā sarvalokasya || 2 ||
meaning:
लब्ध्वाप्य् अलभ्यम् एतज् ज्ञानधनं हृद्गुहान्तकृतनिहितेः |
वसुगुप्तवच् छिवाय हि भवति सदा सर्वलोकस्य || 2 ||
text_mt: Just as for Vasugupta, this wealth of knowledge, difficult to obtain, / having been deposited in the cave of the heart, always leads to the liberation of all people. || 2
